description: This file contains unit tests for safe reading operations on file handles, specifically testing behavior when the handle is closed or when reading data with specific counts in the context of piping.

classes.name: FileHandleSafeReadTests
classes.description: A struct containing unit test methods to verify safe read operations on file handles.

methods.name: read to end safely returns empty for closed handle
methods.description: Tests that reading to end safely from a closed handle returns an empty data set.

methods.name: read safely up to count returns empty for closed handle
methods.description: Tests that reading up to a count from a closed handle returns an empty data set.

methods.name: read to end safely reads pipe contents
methods.description: Verifies that reading to the end safely reads all contents from a pipe after writing data to it.

methods.name: read safely up to count reads incrementally
methods.description: Checks that sequential reads with different counts return the correct incremental sections of pipe data.
